Application Data.NAME: HealthFirst Emergency Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: HealthFirst Emergency Services provides comprehensive emergency medical transportation and response services. Our operations include responding to 911 calls for urgent medical assistance, transporting patients to and from medical facilities, and providing event medical standby services at various public gatherings. We adhere to rigorous quality assurance protocols and maintain an incident reporting system to mitigate risks. Our staff undergoes continual training in emergency response and patient care, and we have implemented strong risk management practices to ensure the safety and security of patient transport. We also comply with all HIPAA regulations regarding the handling of protected health information (PHI). Our fleet is equipped with state-of-the-art medical equipment and is maintained under strict monitoring systems to prevent theft and ensure operational readiness at all times.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 5, 2023, a paramedic sustained an ankle injury while responding to an emergency call, resulting in a Workers' Compensation claim totaling $5,000. The claim is currently in process, with medical treatment ongoing. On March 15, 2023, minor property damage occurred when an ambulance's side mirror was broken during a transport, leading to an estimated repair cost of $1,500. The claim has been closed after repairs were completed. Total losses incurred this year amount to $6,500.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A Safe, UL Listed, Grade 1
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour on-site security personnel and perimeter fencing secured with monitored access control.
